channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Deni Avdija | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Deni Avdija from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Ja Morant, Deni Avdija
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Damian Lillard:

“If I'm advancing the ball and I'm kicking it ahead to Ja Morant or Deni Avdija, I feel good about that. And if they're advancing the ball and kick it out to me for a three, they should feel pretty good about that, too.”

Damian Lillard on Ja Morant, Deni Avdija, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Matas Buzelis on Deni Avdija, Franz Wagner
item.description:
Matas Buzelis:

“To be honest, whoI really want to work with is Deni Avdija. I've been talking with him. It's just, I feel like I was shooting too many threes. I need to get to the rim more. I want to know like how he lowers his shoulder, how he attacks. I seen him in Vegas. We're supposed to work out this weekend. He's somebody, Franz Wagner, probably him, KD, of course. That's who everybody needs to work out with, but I think right now Deni Avdija.”

Matas Buzelis on Deni Avdija, Franz Wagner, Jul 26, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Micah Nori on Deni Avdija, Donovan Clingan, Toumani Camara
item.description:
“He’s excited to be on a team with vets like Dame and Jrue, and he loves the young talent of Deni (Avdija), Scoot, (Donovan) Clingan, (Toumani) Camara … I mean, he mentioned them all by name,”

Micah Nori on Deni Avdija, Donovan Clingan, Toumani Camara, Jul 1, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Tiago Splitter on Stephon Castle, Deni Avdija
item.description:
Splitter on the Castle-Avdija dustup:

“Both teams playing very physical. I just thought that what Castle did was a little excessive and too much and then Deni just reacted, which is normal when you're trying to play and you try to win. I don't think it's a big deal.”

Tiago Splitter on Stephon Castle, Deni Avdija, Apr 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Danny Wolf on Deni Avdija, Ben Saraf
item.description:
Yoav Modai:Danny Wolf:

“I 100% see myself with Ben Saraf and Deni Avdija on the Israeli national team, as long as the option is available”

Danny Wolf on Deni Avdija, Ben Saraf, Mar 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Tatum on Deni Avdija
item.description:
MrBuckBuck: The NBA deputy commisioner,Mark Tatum, on about the fact there is a player from Israel on the World Team (Deni Avdija), and how it helps to the NBA become more gloal:

“Oh, it's amazing. This game is played and loved all over the world on just the fact that nearly 30% of our players (note: NBA players) were born outside the United States; to see Deni as an All-Star now is fantastic. This whole concept of the USA vs. the world - a lot of people have been asking for that, so it's nice to be able to bring the international players together - they're such impactful players, and to create this opportunity for the USA to play the world, especially with our new partner NBC and during the Olympics”

Mark Tatum on Deni Avdija, Feb 15, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Deandre Ayton on Deni Avdija
item.description:
“They definitely was talking crap to me the whole time. … Deni Avdija, every shot he made he kept rubbing it in.”

Deandre Ayton on Deni Avdija, Oct 28, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Matisse Thybulle on Deni Avdija
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Matisse Thybulle on Deni Avdija:

“I don't think I've seen a player get that much better over one season in my entire career.”

Matisse Thybulle on Deni Avdija, Apr 13, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Deni Avdija
item.description:
Chauncey Billups on the quote that’s been circulating about Deni Avdija being their best player:

“I don’t know where the hell that came from. I never said that.”

Chauncey Billups on Deni Avdija, Oct 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Scoot Henderson on Deni Avdija
item.description:
Scoot Henderson on Deni Avdija:

“He's very versatile. He can play both sides. He can shoot, attack the basket, he's super strong. It's going to be a great year for him. I think he'll help us a lot.”

Scoot Henderson on Deni Avdija, Sep 30, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tommy Sheppard on Rui Hachimura, Deni Avdija
item.description:
Chase Hughes:GM Tommy Sheppard on roles for Rui Hachimura and Deni Avdija moving forward:

“I don't see Rui's role changing. He's started since his rookie year.”

Tommy Sheppard on Rui Hachimura, Deni Avdija, Aug 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Russell Westbrook, Deni Avdija
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Scott Brooks on Deni Avdija:

“Russell and Brad push him... they know that this kid is going to be really good this yearand will be even better as [his career continues].”

Scott Brooks on Russell Westbrook, Deni Avdija, Mar 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Tommy Sheppard on Deni Avdija
item.description:
Ava Wallace:Sheppard on Avdija's skillset:

“I would call him a blend player. Whoever's out on the floor, he's able to make plays.”

Tommy Sheppard on Deni Avdija, Nov 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @avarwallace.

item.title: Amare Stoudemire on Deni Avdija
item.description:
Amare Stoudemire on Deni Avdija:

“Deni is on the right track. He works hard. He’s trying to keep himself focused on the game of basketball. He’s always in the gym working. He has a good advantage because he gets a chance to watch guys who are pros train with him. With myself, Quincy Acy, Omri Casspi, we all played in the NBA. He gots to learn from us which is good for him.”

Amare Stoudemire on Deni Avdija, Jun 29, 2020. Source: EuroHoops.net.
